text:
maria: Quick heads-up: planning a quiet-window FF toggle for routing.v3. Window Sat 2026-04-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need a minimal ramp + pin rules.

aj: Sounds good. Proposal: 1% (10m) -> 7% (15m) -> 25% (20m). Hold after each.

kevin: Gate on errors (5xx + infer-fail) > 0.6% OR p95 > 320ms. Require 2 consecutive 5m buckets to trigger.

oncall-ops: I'll be oncall. If hold triggers at stage >1% auto-pin cohort to previous stable and open incident channel.

maria: Deploy-bot, can you schedule and attach a short runbook blurb?

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2026-04-18T02:00Z/2026-04-18T03:00Z. Ramp configured. Auto-pin on breach enabled. Manual resume required after >15m pause.

aj: Also enable model-variant fallback to quantized-v1 on hold. Keeps traffic healthy while we triage.

kevin: Add telemetry tag `rollout=quiet-v3-0418` and record affected cohort IDs when pin happens.

maria: Release notes line: "Night quiet-window rollout for routing.v3: three-stage ramp with SLO gates and auto-pin on breach. Oncall monitoring active." Keep public note short.

oncall-ops: I'll attach alert screenshots and the smoke-test script before EOD Friday.

maria: Approvals?

aj: Approved.

kevin: Approved.

oncall-ops: Approved, I'll be there.

deploy-bot: Rollout APPROVED and notifications scheduled to post in #eng-releases at T-30m and at start.
